environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an AWS ALB configured in HTTP mode (listener on port 80). ALB forwards all traffic to target group on port 8080. No header stripping or validation is configured on the ALB. Security groups allow inbound 80/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. The application is directly reachable by any internet client through the ALB's public DNS name.
